   <div id="docSubImgWrapper" data-setting="userPref-viewMode-pub-sjj-systemPreferred-html">

<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="66021002" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/revelation/21/#v66021002" target="_blank">Revelation 21:2</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>Jehovah anointed his Son</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">To rule over ev’ryone.</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">His throne is established on justice,</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">That God’s will on earth may be done.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sp">Praise Jah for his Son, the Anointed.</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sz">Praise Jesus, O you faithful sheep,</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sp">Who loyally follow day after day</p>
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 sz">and all his commandments keep.</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sp">Praise Jah for his Son, the Anointed,</p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sz">the Ruler of heavenly fame,</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sp">Anointed with exultation and might</p>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sz">to honor God’s holy name.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>Christ’s brothers are chosen and called.</p>
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sz">God gives them their own new birth.</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sp">This bride class will share in the Kingdom</p>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sz">And bring Paradise to this earth.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 sp">Praise Jah for his Son, the Anointed.</p>
<p id="p23" data-pid="23" class="p23 sz">Praise Jesus, O you faithful sheep,</p>
<p id="p24" data-pid="24" class="p24 sp">Who loyally follow day after day</p>
<p id="p25" data-pid="25" class="p25 sz">and all his commandments keep.</p>
<p id="p26" data-pid="26" class="p26 sp">Praise Jah for his Son, the Anointed,</p>
<p id="p27" data-pid="27" class="p27 sz">the Ruler of heavenly fame,</p>
<p id="p28" data-pid="28" class="p28 sp">Anointed with exultation and might</p>
<p id="p29" data-pid="29" class="p29 sz">to honor God’s holy name.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
<p id="p30" data-pid="30" class="p30 se">(See also <a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="20029004" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/proverbs/29/#v20029004" target="_blank">Prov. 29:4;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="23066007-23066008" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/isaiah/66/#v23066007-v23066008" target="_blank"> Isa. 66:7, 8;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="43010004" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/john/10/#v43010004" target="_blank"> John 10:4;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="66005009-66005010" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/revelation/5/#v66005009-v66005010" target="_blank"> Rev. 5:9, 10</a>.)</p>
</div>
<p id="p31" class="displayNone"> </p>
